fieldValues.title: The relation-query return trigger has fired: a problem dossier needs one-hop relation selection
fieldValues.summary: Decision 4f1e12e5 retired the relation-query section source until 'a composition need neither live variant expresses'. LiveWyer Insight (2026-10-30) has that need: a dossier of one problem and every finding that evidences it. Neither discovery-query nor container-subset expresses it without restating 296 evidences edges as container membership.
evidence: LiveWyer Insight demo repository (~/dev/livewyer-insight, tools/link.py): 23 problem containers duplicate 296 evidences relations as membership; the problem-dossiers composition names 23 containerId literals
srs#726 comment 6518740142 (open question 3), with the proposed narrow predicate
srs#851 comment 6518740429: 33 containerId literals, all one 'each child section container' rule
Strategy contract e1cd52e7 (section-source-variants, deferred) names this trigger
fieldValues.body: One hop over one relation type was enough for every document the demo needed; nothing called for multi-hop traversal or a general query language. Decision 0750c62f keeps membership declared and names DiscoveryQuery the computed selection, so the return belongs in DiscoveryQuery as a relation axis (relatedTo, relationType, direction) rather than as a derived container. The owner's framing is vignette d6fd498b: the relation-based container was removed to return with more evidence.
